subject: tests/test-gsd-delivery-verifier.rkt standalone cost, three contexts (spec 1.2)

timing_discrepancy_being_reconciled.stale_header_claim: ~123s standalone (comment near test file header; unattributed, no retained measurement evidence, classified STALE by this benchmark)
timing_discrepancy_being_reconciled.resolution: The 123s header is superseded. On the current dev host the file costs ~30s wall standalone whether or not the compiled cache is warm (warm ~= cold), i.e. cost is dominated by test execution (real-git fixture setup + racket subprocesses), not module compilation. Census numbers (13.5-18.5s) were measured on the census runner class with a different host/compiler-cache state; host-dependent, not contradictory. No completion time or single true number is claimed: the contract is that the recorded provenance travels with each number.

samples.note: extensions suite via scripts/run-tests.rkt; includes sibling extension tests

aggregation.interpretation: Compiled-cache state contributes <0.4s (~1%); preparation work cannot reduce standalone cost materially. Reduction must come from test-body work (fixture setup, subprocess count) or scheduling, not bytecode preparation.

reproducibility: All 9 samples exit 0 at identical commit/tree/package fingerprint; per-sample full provenance retained in tmp bench log and mirrored here; benchmark script methodology retained in wave evidence.
